project_3D_points: project 3D points to 2D pixel coordinates using PyTorch extrinsic and intrinsic camera parameters
project_3D_points_np: project 3D points to 2D pixel coordinates using NumPy extrinsic and intrinsic camera parameters
img_from_cam: apply intrinsic camera parameters and optional radial distortion to camera-space points with PyTorch
img_from_cam_np: apply intrinsic camera parameters and optional radial distortion to camera-space points with NumPy
test_projection: test the projection module by comparing NumPy and PyTorch implementations for numerical consistency
